g.text: Same compute per token, three FFN designs (V4.1-Flash sizes on the right)
N = 4 experts of full width, top-2: C(4,2) = 6 combinations.
The paper's example: 16 experts, top-2 = 120 combinations.
per token: 7 experts x 35.4M = 248M params per layer, effective width 7 x 2304 = 16,128 ~ 3.15 d
owned: 385 x 35.4M = 13.6B per layer, width 173 d. C(384,6) ~ 4.3 x 10^12 combinations.
